purpose: A customer coordinates real bookable services for a wedding, funeral, festival or other gathering, with an all-or-nothing confirmation across supported business calendars.

scope.availability: Only published, nonhidden businesses with enabled booking settings and actual active, unreserved slots. External calendars are unknown, never treated as free.
scope.confirmation: Explicitly review every slot, party size, price and currency. Reserve every selected slot in one transaction or preserve all original availability. Payments remain pay-at-venue and are not collected.
scope.changes: Individual booking rescheduling and cancellation use the existing booking contracts; the plan must reread current booking states and never describe an outdated receipt as current availability.
scope.privacy: Customer owns the plan. Each provider can receive only the event context explicitly shared with its own confirmed booking; private notes and other providers' details are excluded.

acceptance: No partially reserved event when any provider slot conflicts
Opposing concurrent confirmations cannot deadlock or double-book
Stable retries return the same reservation receipt without duplicate bookings
Changed price, currency, slot version, ownership or publication state rejects confirmation
Customer and provider tenant boundaries are independently tested
No external notifications, payments or public QA content
Web and native equivalent review, unknown-response recovery and current-state views
